prompt: Add week support to the savings report range parser. `tokenomics.report.parse_range(spec, *, now=None)` currently accepts today|all|*|<N>d|<N>h|<N>m. Extend it so that `<N>w` (N a non-negative integer, case-insensitive, surrounding whitespace ignored, same as the other units) means the last N weeks: it must return `(end - N*7*86400.0, end)` where `end` is `now` (or the current time). Anything else that ends in `w` but is not exactly digits followed by `w` (e.g. `w`, `1.5w`, `-1w`, `2 w`) must still raise ValueError. Existing units must behave exactly as before, and `build_savings_report(..., range_spec="2w")` / the CLI `--range 2w` should therefore work. Keep the change in packages/python/src/tokenomics/report.py; do not break the existing tests in packages/python/tests/test_report.py. Run tests with `PYTHONPATH=packages/python/src python -m pytest ...` from the repo root (an older copy of the package may be installed; the local source must win).
